description:
Building and growing products for curious, ambitious people who want to learn and keep getting better. Wanna join the tribe?

Why This Role Exists

We’re scaling multiple consumer apps used by millions of people worldwide, so this role is for someone who wants to understand how product, marketing, and engineering connect in real life.

You won’t just build pages. You’ll learn how modern growth teams actually work: starting from a metric, forming a hypothesis, shipping fast, measuring impact, and iterating without ego.

You’ll work closely with Product, Growth, and Monetization and see how experiments directly influence revenue.

What You’ll Learn & Do

You’ll learn how to build and improve web funnels that drive conversions. That means understanding user journeys, experimenting with flows, and optimizing checkout and subscription experiences.

You’ll

  • Implement and iterate on A/B tests.
  • Integrate analytics and tracking properly.
  • Collaborate with designers and product managers to ship improvements.
  • Use AI coding tools to speed up development.
  • Think in terms of impact, not just implementation.

You’ll contribute to real experiments from early on and see what works (and what doesn’t).

Tech You’ll Work With

React, Next.js, TypeScript, Stripe, Amplitude, and modern A/B testing tools. You don’t need to know everything on day one — you’ll learn fast by building.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with solid frontend fundamentals, curiosity about growth and experimentation, and the willingness to take ownership.

If you want to learn how real growth engineering works and ship things that reach millions of users, this is a great place to build.
